'''April 2000 Clarks Summit tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mazz Kards, Clarks Summit, PA on 2 April 2000. [[Michael Dalton]] won it. It is known from Michael Dalton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d444">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-clarks-summit-pa-4-2-00d444/ clarks-summit-pa-4-2-00], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" Dalton, 3 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-clarks-summit-pa-4-2-00d444/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Mazz Kards, Clarks Summit, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Dalton]]
